Movie Details:
Movie: Pilla Nachindi (1999)
Cast: Srikanth, Rachana Banerjee, Sanghavi, Brahmanandam, Kota Srinivasa Rao, Ali, MS Narayana, Babu Mohan
Director: E.V.V. Satyanarayana
Music Director: Koti
Genre: Comedy / Drama / Family

Pilla Nachindi (పిల్ల నచ్చింది) is a 1999 Telugu classic comedy-drama film directed by the legendary king of comedy, E.V.V. Satyanarayana. The movie features Meka Srikanth, Rachana Banerjee, and Sanghavi in the lead roles, supported by an iconic comedy ensemble including Brahmanandam, Kota Srinivasa Rao, MS Narayana, Ali, and Babu Mohan. 

The story revolves around Dattu (Srikanth), a grieving widower whose father-in-law (Kota Srinivasa Rao) tries everything to find him a new bride. Things take a hilarious turn when Dattu insists he will only marry a widow, forcing Lahari (Rachana) to pretend to be one by using a live man's (Brahmanandam) picture from an obituary column! 

Enjoy this ultimate family entertainer packed with non-stop laugh-out-loud moments, beautiful music by Koti, and timeless comedy tracks!
